stages.title: Spec landing and project foundation
stages.goal: Land the standards-based specification, then create the project skeleton, toolchain and manual workflows.
stages.exit: Spec PR merged, AGENTS.md local to this directory in place, toolchain and bindings configured, an empty Worker deployed manually.

stages.title: Keys, serialization, metadata and storage
stages.goal: Build the data model, canonical serialization, key handling, signed metadata and the audit writer that everything else depends on.
stages.exit: Vectors pass in Node and Workers, metadata verifies against a pinned root key, audit chain verifies.

stages.title: Issuance (Basic)
stages.goal: Issue attestations from controller-supplied session records, with proof of possession and replay protection.
stages.exit: A test client obtains a valid attestation; every deny vector is rejected opaquely.

stages.title: Verification and client SDK
stages.goal: Implement verification once, reused by the controller and any client.
stages.exit: The SDK rejects every unverifiable case and exposes only an opaque verdict.

stages.title: Revocation
stages.goal: Publish a signed pull-only revocation list and a controller-authorized revocation path.
stages.exit: Revocation takes effect within the stated worst case and clients fail closed.

stages.title: Basic integration and conformance
stages.goal: Prove Basic end to end against a controller stand-in and cut a Basic candidate.
stages.exit: Basic conformance suite green, retention jobs running, candidate tagged.

stages.title: Standard profile
stages.goal: Add a real non-exportable key host, requester authentication, real-time revocation and profile enforcement.
stages.exit: Standard conformance suite green; Standard refuses to start with software keys.

stages.title: Identity binding and audit coverage
stages.goal: Add per-session identity binding and complete audit coverage.
stages.exit: Binding and audit tests green; no identity or secrets in any record.

stages.title: Operations and security review
stages.goal: Make the service observable and recoverable, and review its security.
stages.exit: Dashboards, alerts, runbooks and restore drill done; threat model and fuzzing complete.

stages.title: Release and sign-off
stages.goal: Run full conformance, regenerate specifications, release and document limits.
stages.exit: Release tagged with conformance report; High documented as unsupported on this stack.

stages.title: High profile (deferred)
stages.goal: Hardware-backed keys and verifiable evidence. Out of scope on the current stack.
stages.exit: Only started after a scope decision to support High.
